title: GPT Image 1.5 joins the image API, and DeepSeek moves to V3.2
summary:
GPT Image 1.5 and DeepSeek V3.2 joined the model lineup, while generation accounting and pricing responses got more precise.

Added `gptimage-large` for text-to-image generation and image editing, and updated `deepseek` to route to V3.2. Veo 3.1 Fast’s registry entry now identifies its existing image-to-video support, so clients can discover that it accepts image inputs.

Balance checks now account for estimated charges on concurrent generation requests before those requests finish. Model information returns Pollen prices under registry field names, and text requests now fail when an image URL cannot be converted rather than continuing with a partial input.

The new site layout gained a dismissible banner linking to the older site. The app directory added Shaper AI, while the README’s Latest News was refreshed with previously added features.

daily.title: GPT Image 1.5 added
daily.text: Use `gptimage-large` to generate images from text or edit them with image inputs. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gptimage-large).

daily.title: DeepSeek moves to V3.2
daily.text: The `deepseek` model now uses DeepSeek V3.2; `deepseek-v3.2` is also available as an alias. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek).
